name: Azure Document Intelligence
mechanism: Applies managed layout and prebuilt document models for OCR, structure, tables, figures and field-oriented extraction across documents.
use_when: Microsoft-hosted enterprise workflows need forms, tables or figures
Typed prebuilt models reduce application extraction code
avoid_when: The workload cannot accept Azure pricing, quotas or model-version coupling
expected_effects: Reduced custom code for common form types
failure_modes: Regional capacity or quotas delay ingestion
